getOpResultHandle(uint8,uint8,bytes).details: The handle is deterministic based on the operation type and input handles. This ensures that the same operation on the same inputs always produces the same result handle.

params.returnType: The type of the result value.

returns.generatedHandle: The deterministic handle for this operation result.

getTrivialEncryptHandle(bytes32,uint8).details: Trivial encryption creates a handle from a known plaintext. The handle is deterministic based on the plaintext value, allowing the same plaintext to always produce the same handle.

params.handleType: The type of encrypted value (euint256, ebool, etc.).

returns.generatedHandle: The deterministic handle for this trivial encryption.

getOpResultHandle(uint8,uint8,bytes).notice: Generates a handle for the result of an encrypted operation.

getTrivialEncryptHandle(bytes32,uint8).notice: Generates a handle for a trivially encrypted value.
